root_ruling: Existing adopted advisory categories selected for TT03-R3-FINAL-01; single mapping for all enclosing guard failures

rules.population: Proven creator PID/Own/namespace mismatch or original creator successful terminal IN with optional HUP
Successful poll ERR/NVAL/unknown/HUP-only/inconsistent count or flags
Malformed syntax/native value or missing required CLOEXEC
Reached listed resource/unavailable errno or namespace-kind ENOTTY
Other reached non-close errno including missing proc member
Actual non-time limit with exact LimitKind and consumed charges
Actual cancellation stop without an earlier native error
Actual local deadline stop without an earlier native error
Reached temporary close error; consumed original owner and sticky error

precedence: Preserve the first actual failure; a later semantic mismatch never overwrites earlier transport/parse/kind/flag/control/limit failure.
Reached temporary close failure uses temporary_close_error with actual errno and consumed owner.
For other reached native errors use native_denied/native_unavailable/native_io, including special ENOTTY only at the namespace-kind ioctl.
If no earlier native error exists, preserve genuine cancellation/local-deadline/non-time limit at its actual checkpoint.
A successfully reached semantic context contradiction uses semantic_wrong_context; inconclusive poll and malformed are distinct populations.
evidence_relations: Successful creator poll keeps actual ready count and signed raw revents, including invalid or terminal outputs.
Failed/unperformed poll has both output fields null; native errno is present only when reached.
Missing CLOEXEC retains actual successful GETFD flags; malformed syntax is not a fabricated native errno.
No category creates expected-refusal authority, a hook entry, native cleanup success or a public GuardReason API.
